rule_or_requirement: A candidate must preserve valid pixel-only completion before shorter simulated lap time can advance it.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames, visible road and obstacle pixels, pixel HUD speed, and actions from two exact-hash fixed actors.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Compare four already activated single-change runtime mechanisms: bend-conditioned gas floor, exit throttle pulse, approach-rate brake, and mild-bend outer entry, against two frozen controls.
expected_success_endpoint: At least the selected safety control's finish count across twelve matched fresh TUNE cells, then a lower median finished lap time and no invalid actions.
control: Primary selected_full_road_guard safety actor and secondary frozen apex_line actor with the exact same 12 cells and checkpoint hashes.
falsifier: Any lower finish count than the selected safety control, invalid action, or tied completion without lower median finished lap time.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Tracks 1–3 × seeds 308–311, six fixed arms including four independent candidates and two controls, 2000 decisions per cell and full traces.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, registered 1800-second profile cap and 72-episode denominator; no train from tune, held-out, confirmation, blind, upload, or submission.
